title: Cortical responses minimize the free energy of a stimulus

statements.text: Evoked cortical responses are the brain trying to minimize the free energy a stimulus induces, which encodes the most likely cause of that stimulus. Inference and learning in the sensory brain rest on the same principle.

sources.quote: Cortical responses can be seen as the brain’s attempt to minimize the free energy induced by a stimulus and thereby encode the most likely cause of that stimulus.
